description: Live DeFi lending/LP yield pools, and every pool is tagged with an entry verdict (SUSTAINABLE | DECAYING | OUTLIER | AVOID) + a 0-100 risk_score right in the list — a go/no-go at the browse stage, not just raw rows. Each row carries project, chain, symbol, pool id, APY breakdown incl. 1d/7d/30d trend + apyBase7d/apyMean30d, IL risk incl. il7d, exposure, reward/underlying tokens, outlier flag, mu/sigma, DefiLlama stability forecast, TVL and a stablecoin flag, from DefiLlama, ranked by TVL (or risk-adjusted APY = apy/sigma). For the deep go/no-go on the one pool you're sizing into, pass its pool id to yield_entry_verdict. Cost: $0.005 USDC per call via x402.

chain.description: Filter by chain. Short names like eth, arb, op, avax, matic, sol, bnb resolve to the DefiLlama canonical chain name.

project.description: Filter by protocol — the family name (aave, uniswap, curve) resolves all versions, or an exact DefiLlama slug (aave-v3)

name: defi_yields
